title: Vehicle, Sports, Equipment and Pet Care Cover Across the Travel Protection Plans
content:
Beyond the medical, baggage and delay sections, the Travel Protection Plans carry a group of benefits that
only the higher plans hold at all: damage to a hired vehicle, cover for listed adventure sports, business
equipment, and kennel or pet care where the traveller's return is delayed.

| Plan | Rental vehicle damage | Rental damage deductible | Listed adventure sports covered | Business equipment | Kennel or pet care |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Basics Essential | 0 | 0 | No | 0 | 0 |
| Trip Basics Standard | 0 | 0 | No | 0 | 0 |
| TripGuard Plus | 25000 | 250 | No | 500 | 150 |
| TripGuard Premier | 35000 | 100 | Yes | 1000 | 300 |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 35000 | 100 | Yes | 1000 | 300 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 25000 | 250 | No | 1500 | 300 |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 50000 | 0 | Yes | 3000 | 500 |

Amounts are in USD. A limit of 0 marks a benefit the plan does not carry; the rental damage benefit is a limit
for each rental, and the business equipment and pet care benefits are limits for each insured traveller.

## Where the range divides

Neither Trip Basics plan carries rental vehicle damage, business equipment or pet care cover at all. The rental
damage benefit appears at 25000 on TripGuard Plus and Annual Multi-Trip Traveller, both with a deductible of
250, at 35000 on TripGuard Premier and Cancel For Any Reason Elite with a deductible of 100, and at 50000 on
Annual Multi-Trip Executive with no deductible. Listed adventure sports are covered on TripGuard Premier, Cancel
For Any Reason Elite and Annual Multi-Trip Executive and excluded on the other four. Business equipment runs
500, 1000, 1000, 1500 and 3000 and pet care 150, 300, 300, 300 and 500 across the five plans that carry them.
